records.title: TF-MossFormer: Integrating Convolution Gated Local-Global Attentions for Enhanced Time-Frequency Domain Monaural Speech Separation
records.reason: TF-MossFormer targets monaural speech separation quality, not LLM inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: Agree on the Model, Verify the Inference: GKR Protocols for HND-Based Transformer Inference
records.reason: The contribution verifies outsourced HND Transformer execution against substitution/incomplete-computation attacks; it is a security protocol, not an efficiency method.

records.title: MemTools: A Unified Research Framework for Interoperable Agent Memory
records.reason: MemTools is an interoperability framework and evaluation interface for agent-memory research. The abstract reports integration and coordination evaluations, not reduced LLM inference tokens, latency, memory, energy, or serving cost.

records.title: Anti-Periodic Positional Encoding: Möbius Boundary Conditions Make In-Context Retrieval Reliable
records.reason: Möbius RoPE improves retrieval reliability in 160M/410M pretrained models at unchanged perplexity; its stated contribution is positional encoding/retrieval quality rather than inference-efficiency reduction.

records.title: Context-weighted Discrete Flow Matching
records.reason: The reported contribution improves sample quality at roughly unchanged per-sample compute rather than reducing inference cost/latency, and is tested at 170M scale. Its relevance to inference efficiency is therefore weak absent evidence that equal-quality generation can use fewer sampling steps or lower serving resources.
